title: European farmers face ‘unprecedented crisis’ after successive heatwaves

paragraphs.en: Successive intense heatwaves and an increasingly severe, continent-wide drought have left many of Europe’s farmers in an “unprecedented” crisis, with vegetable and grain growers in particular warning of “catastrophic” harvests.
paragraphs.zh: 接连不断的强烈热浪，以及一场日益严重、席卷全欧洲大陆的干旱，已使欧洲众多农民陷入“前所未有”的危机，蔬菜和谷物种植者尤其警告将迎来“灾难性”的收成。

paragraphs.en: French vegetable production is down by “a very significant extent” compared with previous years, French growers have said, with shortfalls put at 25% for courgettes, 35% for lettuces, 40% for peas, 60% for broccoli and 50% to 100% for artichokes.
paragraphs.zh: 法国种植者表示，与往年相比，法国蔬菜产量“大幅”下降，其中西葫芦减产25%，生菜减产35%，豌豆减产40%，西兰花减产60%，洋蓟减产50%至100%。

paragraphs.en: “The vegetable sector is facing a historic crisis,” said Prince de Bretagne, which groups together more than 1,300 vegetable producers in Brittany, calling for “urgent action” to address a “dramatic” fall in yields and in the quality of many crops.
paragraphs.zh: “蔬菜行业正面临一场历史性危机。”布列塔尼亲王（Prince de Bretagne）合作社表示，该合作社汇集了布列塔尼地区1300多名蔬菜生产者，呼吁采取“紧急行动”应对许多作物产量和品质“急剧”下降的问题。

paragraphs.en: Accelerated, human-caused global heating and a supersized El Niño have scorched fields across Europe this summer, with plant development prevented by temperatures routinely exceeding 30C and often 35C, almost no rainfall, and hot winds.
paragraphs.zh: 今年夏天，由人类活动加速导致的全球变暖，再加上一次超强厄尔尼诺现象，烤焦了欧洲各地的农田：气温频频超过30摄氏度、甚至经常达到35摄氏度，几乎没有降雨，还有热风侵袭，作物的生长受到阻碍。

paragraphs.en: “Usually one region fares better, which helps compensate,” Eric Legras, of the 4,400-member French canned and frozen vegetable producers’ association, told Le Monde . “This year, all our main production areas have been hit, and at the same time.”
paragraphs.zh: 拥有4400名成员的法国罐头和冷冻蔬菜生产者协会的埃里克·勒格拉告诉《世界报》：“通常会有某个地区表现较好，这有助于弥补损失。但今年，我们所有主要产区都同时遭受了打击。”

paragraphs.en: Cereal production has been equally hard hit, with the agriculture ministry estimating the maize harvest in France – Europe’s largest grains producer – will be down by 35% on 2025 levels at about 9m tonnes, a quantity last seen in 1980.
paragraphs.zh: 谷物生产同样受到重创。法国农业部估计，作为欧洲最大的谷物生产国，法国今年的玉米收成将比2025年下降35%，约为900万吨，这一产量水平上一次出现还是在1980年。

paragraphs.en: Part of the fall is due to farmers’ switching to other crops, such as sunflowers, the ministry said, but it also reflects the impact of this summer’s vicious heatwaves, which have battered the crucial crop during critical stages of its growth cycle.
paragraphs.zh: 农业部表示，减产的一部分原因是农民转向了向日葵等其他作物，但这也反映了今年夏天酷热热浪的影响，它在关键的生长阶段重创了这一至关重要的作物。

paragraphs.en: That is likely to cause big problems for livestock farmers. With dairy cows typically starting to suffer from heat stress above 25C, many producers have already reported milk yields down by 10%-15%. Most are now also concerned about winter feed.
paragraphs.zh: 这很可能给牲畜养殖户带来大麻烦。由于奶牛通常在气温超过25摄氏度时就开始出现热应激，许多生产者已经报告牛奶产量下降10%至15%。如今，大多数人还开始担心冬季饲料的问题。
